post.caption: Nick Offerman faked three proposals. Before the real one, he staged them for Megan Mullally in Paris, with prop rings from a Will and Grace costume department. One fake ring was dropped from the top of the Eiffel Tower, and another fell down a grate. He told the story in Playboy in 2013 and again in 2025. The real proposal came in 2002 in London's Regent's Park, with a hand carved walnut ring box shaped like a heart. Their guests thought they were coming to an Emmy party, and they married in September 2003, the night before the Emmys.
